name: bone_golem
description: a Bone Golem, a hulking construct of carved ivory-coloured bones bound with gold bands set with round blue gems: an elephant skull for a head with a curled trunk, two curved tusks and small glowing blue eyes, a ribcage torso with a blue gem in the middle, thick bone arms with big bone fists and thick bone legs; a huge bone club (a giant thighbone with a gold band) raised in his LEFT fist
hands: the bone club stays in his left fist on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty bone fist hanging low on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the bone club is lifted up over the head with its knobbed end pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the bone club cocked behind the skull with its knobbed end hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right bone fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the bone club is level, its knobbed end pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the bone club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right bone fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the bone club carries on down until its knobbed end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the trunk and tusks swinging
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the bone club lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the elephant skull snaps back toward the upper-left, its blue eye-lights flickering, the ribcage jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right bone fist flung out to the left, club arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the bone club dipping, the empty right bone fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the empty right bone fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the skull droops, the bone club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the bone club's knobbed end resting on the ground, the empty right bone arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the bone club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and the elephant skull toward the upper-left, tusks pointing up; the bone club lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: the skull and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the gold bands rattle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the blue eye-lights dark, the bone club on the ground beside him
